descriptions.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Royalty' Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Royalty' is a newer selection of a red full moon Japanese maple that was selected by Talon Buchholz. The foliage appears & has long narrow lobes that give this tree quite an attractive look in the landscape. 'Royalty' turns from orange red to purple red in the fall. We expect 'Royalty reach 12-14 ft in 10 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Royalty' 红叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。 'Royalty' 是由 Talon Buchholz 选出的较新红叶满月日本枫品种。 其叶片姿态舒展，且裂片细长狭窄，使这株树在景观中极具观赏性。 'Royalty' 到秋季会由橙红色转为紫红色。 我们预计 'Royalty' 在 10 年内可长至 12-14 英尺。
